format: OSwind full-development natural diarization comparison v1

dataset.selection: Every dev RTTM identifier in the pinned official annotation ZIP, sorted lexicographically before corpus inference; includes ten previously evaluated development clips. No result-driven exclusions, no oracle counts. Not held-out/test-set quality.
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0; research use; original video copyright retained
dataset.attribution: Chung, Huh, Nagrani, Afouras and Zisserman. Spot the conversation: speaker diarisation in the wild. Interspeech 2020.

asset_provenance.retrieval: Caller-provided ZIP; no publisher fingerprint claim
asset_provenance.checksum_scope: Locally computed SHA-256 after official HTTPS/ETag-bound download and complete per-member CRC extraction; not a publisher-supplied SHA-256 attestation.

settings.uem: Entire source WAV duration, including unannotated silence

repetition_stability.scope: Two repeated measurements, not a statistical estimate of variance.

baseline.scope: Complete pinned development selection, not held-out/test-set or competitor app quality. Includes previously evaluated development clips. Raw diarization before ASR projection. Each clip uses a fresh process; later repetitions reuse its backend. OS/Core ML compilation caches uncontrolled. macOS process RSS excludes device allocation, background daemons and system power.
